 Bigg Boss 20: Salman Khan takes ScoutOP to task over physical fight with Yung DSA, questions his influence on gamers; watch
 Salman Khan confronts ScoutOP over his physical altercation with Yung DSA in Bigg Boss 20, questioning his aggressive behaviour and influence on young gamers.
 Nitesh Kumar Sahoo 
 14 Nov 2026 22:24 IST
 Bigg Boss 20: Salman Khan Takes ScoutOP to Task Photograph: (Instagram/Jio Hotstar (screengrab))
 Physical aggression inside the Bigg Boss house has once again become a talking point. This time, gamer ScoutOP faces questions from host Salman Khan over his clash with fellow contestant Yung DSA.
 Advertisment In the upcoming Weekend Ka Vaar episode, Salman addresses the captaincy task altercation and questions Scout's attitude towards it.
 Also Check: Bigg Boss 20: Gauahar Khan calls out Love Gill for distancing herself from ScoutOP at his lowest, questions her actions 
 Advertisment Salman Questions Scout's Responsibility As A Gamer 
 The promo shows him highlighting Scout's remarks about repeating the act before taking a dig at his aggressive approach. Salman says, "Dhamki aur dhakka. What a combination."
 Salman does not stop at addressing the physical confrontation. He also brings up Scout's influence over his gaming community and questions the message his behaviour sends to those who follow him. Pointing out that Scout represents the country, the host expresses disappointment over the example he is setting.
 He says, "Desh ko represent karne wala ek gamer agar aise inspire karta hai, toh all the best un inspire hone wale logon ko."
 View this post on Instagram 
 The host also touches upon the betrayal angle surrounding the fight, making it clear that Scout's conduct itself deserves attention before even discussing the friendship fallout.
 What Led To ScoutOP And Yung DSA's Fallout? 
 The controversy unfolded during a captaincy task when a heated exchange between ScoutOP and Yung DSA turned physical. Scout pushed Yung, despite the two sharing a close friendship inside the house.
 The incident left Yung hurt, with the contestant expressing disappointment over what he considered a betrayal by a trusted friend.
 Bigg Boss subsequently announced four disciplinary measures against Scout. These included nomination for the rest of the season, disqualification from all upcoming captaincy tasks, restrictions on special powers and a warning that any further misconduct could lead to immediate eviction.
 Must Check: Bigg Boss 20: Kanika Mann spots Scout OP’s ‘Feelings’ for Love Gill, her response leaves him surprised; watch 
 With Salman now addressing the controversy, Scout's actions and their consequences are set to take centre stage in the upcoming Weekend Ka Vaar episode.
